title: Understanding Singular Values
text: Singular values are related to the variance captured by each principal component. The larger the singular value, the more variance that component captures.

title: Calculating Variance from Singular Values
text: The variance captured by a principal component is proportional to the square of its singular value. To find the total variance captured by the first two components, consider the squares of the first two singular values.
